newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH ROCLA JAN-APRIL PROFIT RISES TO FIM 9 MLN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH ROCLA JAN-APRIL PROFIT RISES TO FIM 9 MLN.

text.p: Four months to April 31-
(million markka unless stated)
Profit before extraordinary items, tax 9.1 vs 4.6
Earnings per share (markka) 3.55 vs 1.79
Net sales 91.7 vs 70.5
Operating profit 10.4 vs 6.1
Operating profit before depreciation 11.5 vs 7.0
Depreciation 1.2 vs 0.9
Net financial items charge 1.3 vs 1.6 charge
Net profit 9.1 vs 4.6
Equity to assets ratio (percent) 24.6 vs 14.0
NOTE - Full name of warehouse trucks maker is Rocla Oy. The
company said in a statement that the European market for
warehouse trucks was expected to go on growing slightly, but
real-term prices would ease in the medium term.
Rocla said it expected to be able to increase output volumes
without significant new fixed investments.
"It is believed that the profitability of operations in the
years immediately ahead will remain at least at the level
achieved in the 1996 financial year," Rocla said.
In 1996, Rocla's operating profit was 18.5 million markka on
net sales of 225.6 million markka, profit before extraordinary
items and tax was 13.3 million markka and EPS was 9.55 markka.
